description: Independent hydropathy test of the AT5G03810 signal peptide and search for internal transmembrane segments
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
h={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9FFN0.fasta",headers=h,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
print("len",len(seq))
# Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
hp=np.array([KD[c] for c in seq])
w=19; sm=np.convolve(hp,np.ones(w)/w,mode='same')
print("max KD(19) window overall: %.2f at residue %d"%(sm.max(),int(sm.argmax())+1))
print("max KD(19) after residue 40: %.2f at %d"%(sm[40:].max(),int(sm[40:].argmax())+41))
print("N-terminal 1-30:",seq[:30])
# n/h/c region of the putative signal peptide
nreg=seq[:5]; hreg=seq[5:19]; creg=seq[19:26]
print("n-region(1-5) %s net charge %+d"%(nreg,sum(1 for c in nreg if c in 'KR')-sum(1 for c in nreg if c in 'DE')))
print("h-region(6-19) %s mean KD %.2f"%(hreg,np.mean([KD[c] for c in hreg])))
print("c-region(20-26) %s  (-3,-1 relative to cleavage after 24) = %s,%s"%(creg,seq[21],seq[23]))
print("C-terminus (last 8):",seq[-8:],"-> KDEL/HDEL present:", seq[-4:] in ("KDEL","HDEL"))
# N-glycosylation sequons N-X-S/T, X != P
seq_sites=[i+1 for i in range(len(seq)-2) if seq[i]=='N' and seq[i+1]!='P' and seq[i+2] in 'ST']
print("N-X-S/T sequons:",seq_sites)
# charge / pI-ish and Cys count
print("Cys positions:",[i+1 for i,c in enumerate(seq) if c=='C'])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.6))
ax.plot(np.arange(1,len(seq)+1),sm,lw=1.2,color="#3b6ea5")
ax.axhline(1.6,ls='--',c='crimson',lw=0.9); ax.text(250,1.7,"1.6 (membrane-helix threshold)",fontsize=8,color='crimson')
ax.axvspan(1,24,color="#f2c14e",alpha=.45)
ax.text(26,3.0,"UniProt SIGNAL 1-24",fontsize=9)
for s in seq_sites: ax.axvline(s,color="#999",lw=0.6,ls=':')
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy\n(19-residue window)")
ax.set_title("AT5G03810 (Q9FFN0): one N-terminal hydrophobic segment, no internal membrane-helix-scale peak")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
